generation.explanation: Drag the four colored handles to change the sine wave directly: A controls its signed amplitude, B controls its frequency, C shifts it horizontally, and D shifts it vertically. The period is 2π/B, so moving the B handle closer to C makes the oscillations faster. Drag A below the midline to flip the wave.
